title: Claude Tool Shim CMD Pattern
desc: Reusable pattern for creating Claude-named CMD wrappers (Edit.cmd, Write.cmd etc.) that route through wkharness so all existing guards fire identically for Codex and Claude Code sessions.
steps: PATTERN: ToolName.cmd = absolute-path relay to ToolName.ps1. ToolName.ps1 = stdin JSON reader + wkharness pre-check + actual tool logic.
CMD FILE: use absolute path to .ps1 (D:\GitHub\personal-docs\tools\ToolName.ps1), NOT %~dp0 -- %~dp0 resolves to the symlink dir, not the source dir.

PS1 STDIN TRICK (PS5.1): write raw to tmpfile via [IO.File]::WriteAllText, then cmd /c powershell wkharness.ps1 < tmpfile. Cannot pipe variable to child process stdin in PS5.1. Clean tmpfile in finally block.
HARNESS INTEGRATION: ps1 pipes stdin JSON with tool_name matching Claude built-in name. wkharness fires existing guards (pace-guard, skill-edit-guard etc.) identically to real Claude tool calls.

PACE-GUARD NOTE: Write/Edit guards fire based on isSonnetSession. When Codex calls Write.cmd, session_id is empty so isSonnetSession defaults to true -- pace-guard may block Codex writes when Sonnet is over budget. Improvement: empty session_id should skip Sonnet pace-guard (file suggest to harness team).
READ.CMD EXCEPTION: Read has no pace-guard in harness (Claude Code Read is also unrestricted). Read.cmd wkharness pre-check is a no-op for pace, but still catches forbidden path patterns.
SYMLINK INSTALL: wkwrap --install extended with mklink WKAppBot/bin/ToolName.cmd -> personal-docs/tools/ToolName.cmd. Source in personal-docs, symlinks in WKAppBot/bin/.
AGENTS.MD: FORBIDDEN write_file read_file. REQUIRED shell echo json pipe to Write.cmd or Edit.cmd.
author: claude
